jobs.description:
Job Title: Senior Histopathology Slide Quality Specialist

**Location:**
United Arab Emirates (Remote)

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Work Arrangement:**
100% Remote — Work From Home

**Level:**
Senior

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Histopathology Slide Quality Specialist to support the technical quality, consistency, and reliability of histopathology slide preparation and digital slide review processes. This role focuses on remote quality oversight, authorized digital slide assessment, technical documentation, image quality analysis, and continuous improvement of laboratory quality systems.

The successful candidate will collaborate virtually with pathologists, laboratory scientists, histotechnologists, quality teams, and healthcare stakeholders to identify technical quality issues, monitor performance indicators, and recommend improvements. The position is fully remote and does not involve physical specimen processing, laboratory bench work, or direct patient care.

Key Responsibilities

* Review authorized digital histopathology slides for technical quality, image clarity, staining consistency, tissue representation, and suitability for further professional review.
* Assess digital slide records for technical defects, including artifacts, uneven staining, focus problems, tissue folding, and other preparation-related issues.
* Monitor slide quality indicators, recurring defects, laboratory performance trends, and quality control outcomes.
* Review histopathology quality documentation, standard operating procedures, technical records, and corrective action reports.
* Identify potential sources of slide preparation and scanning inconsistencies and recommend practical improvement measures.
* Support quality assurance activities through digital record audits, trend analysis, and structured reporting.
* Coordinate remotely with laboratory personnel to investigate reported technical quality concerns and track corrective and preventive actions.
* Assist with the review of digital imaging workflows, slide traceability records, and electronic quality management systems.
* Prepare technical summaries, quality dashboards, audit documentation, and management reports.
* Support staff training initiatives by developing technical guidance and quality improvement materials.
* Maintain confidentiality and comply with applicable data protection, laboratory quality, and healthcare information governance requirements.

Qualifications and Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Histotechnology, Medical Laboratory Science, Biomedical Science, Pathology-related disciplines, or a relevant field.
* Significant professional experience in histopathology, histotechnology, laboratory quality assurance, or digital pathology quality management.
* Strong understanding of tissue processing, embedding, microtomy, staining methods, slide preparation, and histopathology laboratory workflows.
* Experience reviewing digital pathology images and identifying technical slide quality issues.
* Familiarity with laboratory quality management systems, document control, audit procedures, and corrective and preventive actions.
* Knowledge of relevant laboratory standards, accreditation requirements, and quality control principles.
* Strong analytical, documentation, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment and collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams.

What you’ll do

* **Build AI automations.** Work with the team to identify repetitive tasks, connect the right tools, and test the workflow from start to finish. Once it’s live, check how much time it saves and whether the team can rely on it.
* **Improve how we manage projects in Odoo.** Build rules for reminders, task assignments, and follow-ups so our coaches know which students need attention and what needs to happen next. Coordinate meetings and follow up directly when something needs a person’s attention.
* **Build and improve websites.** Design and publish websites and landing pages, review how visitors use them, and make changes where the design or flow could work better.
* **Automate parts of our content production.** Connect the steps between an original recording or idea and a post that’s ready for review. Help us publish consistently across Entreproneur’s social channels while keeping the content in our own voice.
* **Run and analyse ad campaigns.** Use campaign and website data to understand what’s working, decide what to test, and put those changes into practice.
* **Work with our developer on custom solutions.** You’ll own what you can build yourself. When an idea needs custom code, you’ll explain what the team needs, give the developer a clear brief, and test the result with the people who will use it.

**What you bring**  
You’ve built websites or landing pages yourself, have an eye for design, and understand the basics of digital advertising and website analytics. You’re comfortable finding your way around a CRM, ERP, or project management platform. You can learn Odoo on the job, and coding experience is optional.

**Hands-on experience building connected AI workflows carries the most weight in this role.** That could mean using Make, n8n, Zapier, native integrations, or similar tools. You understand what starts a workflow, what information needs to move between systems, where AI adds value, and how to spot when something goes wrong.

Odoo is the main system we use to manage student projects, coordinate coaching, and track follow-ups. You can learn Odoo on the job. What matters most is that you can look at how our team works, spot a manual step, and connect the right tools to automate it.

**What it’s like to work with me**  
I move quickly, and priorities can change during the day. I value someone who asks the right questions, builds a first version I can try, and tells me when there’s a simpler way to achieve the same result. I also need someone I can hand an idea to and trust to follow it through,

Bros Master Mind Events is looking for an experienced **Procurement Administrator** to support our Procurement & Supply Chain team during a busy event and project season.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in **procurement administration**, **Odoo ERP**, **supplier follow-ups**, **purchase orders**, **material tracking**, and **documentation**, preferably within the events, exhibitions, fit-out, fabrication, or manufacturing industry.

* Coordinate with the Store Team regarding goods received, material issuance, and project returns.
* Assist with RFQs, supplier quotations, price comparison sheets, and vendor documentation.
